news.titleEn: Iran pitches seven-day roadmap to end conflict with US
news.conclusionEn: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi unveiled at the UN a seven-day plan to halt fighting on all fronts, unfreeze at least $12 billion in assets, lift oil sanctions and the US naval blockade, and reopen the Strait of Hormuz on day seven.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗提出七天停战路线图，第七天重开霍尔木兹海峡
news.whyEn: A credible path to reopening Hormuz would ease the oil shock driving global inflation and bond yields; failure keeps energy prices and rate-hike fears elevated.
news.whyZh: 若海峡重开，油价与通胀压力将明显缓解，全球利率预期随之改变
news.detailEn: The proposal closely mirrors a June memorandum of understanding between Washington and Tehran that collapsed within weeks. A White House official described 'positive and constructive discussions through the mediators' but signaled the US would not rush into a deal. Reports that negotiators were discussing a phased reopening already pushed oil lower on Friday. Analysts caution that core positions on Iran's nuclear program remain far apart.
news.detailZh: 该方案与6月美伊达成但数周内即告破裂的谅解备忘录高度相似。白宫官员称通过调解方进行了「积极且建设性的讨论」，但表示不会仓促达成协议。有关分阶段重开海峡的谈判消息已令周五油价回落。分析人士提醒，双方在伊朗核问题上的核心立场仍相距甚远。

news.titleEn: Dow jumps more than 470 points Friday; stocks notch winning week despite Treasury yield surge
news.conclusionEn: The Dow rose 478.64 points (0.93%) to 51,828.62, the S&P 500 gained 0.51% to 7,743.41 and the Nasdaq added 0.5% to 27,068.72, securing weekly gains for all three indexes.
news.conclusionZh: 道指周五涨逾470点，美股三大指数收获周线上涨
news.whyEn: Equities shrugged off a historic bond selloff as oil eased on Iran-deal hopes, showing investors are still willing to buy dips despite 5%+ yields.
news.whyZh: 即便美债收益率超5%，油价回落仍让股市企稳，风险偏好尚存
news.detailEn: The week was volatile: the Dow fell for three straight sessions as the 10-year yield hit its highest since 2007 and the 30-year its highest since 2004. Friday's rebound came as reports of US-Iran talks pulled crude lower and eased inflation fears. Tech optimism, including bullish AI-spending forecasts, also helped. Investors now look to next week's jobs data and US-China trade details.
news.detailZh: 本周市场波动剧烈：10年期美债收益率创2007年来新高、30年期创2004年来新高，道指一度连跌三日。周五美伊谈判消息压低油价、缓解通胀担忧，推动反弹。对AI资本开支的乐观预测也提振科技股。投资者接下来关注下周的就业数据和中美贸易细节。

news.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield is little changed to end a volatile week
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year Treasury yield held near 5.16% on Friday after hitting its highest since June 2007 on Thursday, while the 30-year stayed near 5.49%.
news.conclusionZh: 10年期美债收益率周五持稳于5.16%附近
news.whyEn: Yields this high reset borrowing costs for mortgages, companies and governments worldwide, and keep pressure on equity valuations.
news.whyZh: 高利率抬升全球房贷、企业与政府融资成本，压制资产估值
news.detailEn: The benchmark yield had jumped about 23 basis points over the prior three sessions on hawkish Fed commentary and strong economic data. Falling oil prices on US-Iran deal hopes offered the bond market some relief on Friday. The 2-year yield slipped about 3 basis points to around 4.86%. Markets remain focused on whether the Fed will hike again after its September increase.
news.detailZh: 此前三个交易日，受美联储鹰派表态和强劲经济数据影响，10年期收益率累计上升约23个基点。周五美伊协议预期压低油价，为债市带来喘息。2年期收益率下行约3个基点至4.86%左右。市场焦点仍是美联储9月加息后是否会再次加息。

news.titleEn: Details on U.S.-China trade negotiations coming Monday, USTR Greer says
news.conclusionEn: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Washington will release details of its trade progress with China on Monday, after the Trump-Xi White House summit produced few concrete announcements.
news.conclusionZh: 美贸易代表称周一公布中美贸易谈判细节
news.whyEn: The world's two largest economies setting managed-trade terms affects tariffs, supply chains and exporters from farm goods to consumer products.
news.whyZh: 中美「管理式贸易」安排影响关税、供应链及农产品和消费品出口商
news.detailEn: Greer described a 'managed trade situation,' with agreements covering a subset of goods traded on more favorable terms — US agricultural products and medical devices in exchange for non-sensitive Chinese consumer goods. The two sides also agreed to extend their broader trade truce by two months. Thursday's summit was heavy on pageantry but light on breakthroughs on sensitive issues. Monday's release will show how substantive the deal really is.
news.detailZh: 格里尔称目前是「管理式贸易」，双方就部分商品以更优惠条件贸易达成共识——美国出口农产品和医疗器械，换取中国非敏感消费品。双方还同意将更广泛的贸易休战延长两个月。周四峰会礼仪隆重，但在敏感议题上鲜有突破。周一公布的细节将检验协议的实质内容。

news.titleEn: Saudi Arabia crude oil exports hit highest level since Iran war began despite pipeline outage
news.conclusionEn: Saudi Arabia is exporting about 6 million barrels per day of crude in September, per Kpler, up nearly 80% from August and the highest since the Iran war began seven months ago.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特9月原油出口达日均600万桶，创伊朗战争以来新高
news.whyEn: More Saudi barrels help cap oil prices and ease the global supply squeeze, even as the Hormuz standoff continues.
news.whyZh: 沙特增供有助压制油价、缓解全球原油紧缺
news.detailEn: The kingdom boosted shipments even after closing its East-West pipeline due to drone damage. Instead, it redirected exports back through the Strait of Hormuz via a shipping lane the US military carved out along Oman's coast. The surge comes despite escalating Houthi missile attacks on Saudi territory. Physical supply nonetheless remains tight, keeping Brent near $100.
news.detailZh: 东西输油管道因无人机袭击受损关闭后，沙特仍提高了出口量。它改为经霍尔木兹海峡出口，借助美军沿阿曼海岸开辟的航道。这一增长发生在胡塞武装对沙特导弹袭击升级之际。但实物供应仍然偏紧，布伦特油价徘徊在100美元附近。

news.titleEn: Goldman Sees Hyperscaler AI Capex Rising 50% to $1.2 Trillion
news.conclusionEn: Goldman Sachs strategists forecast AI infrastructure spending by the five largest US hyperscalers will rise by more than half next year to $1.2 trillion, above the $1.1 trillion consensus.
news.conclusionZh: 高盛预计明年美国五大云巨头AI资本开支增五成至1.2万亿美元
news.whyEn: This spending drives chipmakers, power and data-center supply chains — but increasingly relies on debt, raising financial risk.
news.whyZh: 巨额投入带动芯片、电力和数据中心产业链，但越来越依赖举债
news.detailEn: Goldman expects direct hyperscaler debt issuance to rise from about $250 billion in 2026 to roughly $400 billion in 2027, when debt would fund about 35% of capex. The bank separately said it is underweight hyperscaler bonds because of the surge in debt supply. Between 2028 and 2030, the companies may need around $1.3 trillion in additional financing. The forecast helped lift tech shares on Friday.
news.detailZh: 高盛预计云巨头直接发债规模将从2026年约2500亿美元升至2027年约4000亿美元，届时债务将覆盖约35%的资本开支。该行另表示，因债券供给激增而低配云巨头债券。2028至2030年，这些公司可能还需约1.3万亿美元额外融资。该预测周五提振了科技股。

news.titleEn: Oracle sends 'force majeure' notice about data center project — stock drops 3%
news.conclusionEn: Oracle invoked force majeure on its Project Jupiter AI data center in New Mexico, seeking to delay payments to developer Blue Owl if the site misses its 2028 start, sending its shares lower.
news.conclusionZh: 甲骨文就新墨西哥AI数据中心发出「不可抗力」通知，股价下跌
news.whyEn: It is a warning sign that the AI data-center boom faces permitting, power and financing bottlenecks, hitting partners and lenders.
news.whyZh: 暴露AI数据中心热潮面临审批、电力和融资瓶颈，波及合作方与债权人
news.detailEn: Project Jupiter, part of the Stargate AI infrastructure effort backed by OpenAI, Oracle and SoftBank, has faced local opposition and regulatory setbacks. A gas pipeline meant to power the site has not been authorized by the New Mexico State Land Office. Blue Owl and power supplier Bloom Energy shares also fell. About $18 billion of debt tied to the campus is reportedly quoted at 89 to 91 cents on the dollar.
news.detailZh: Jupiter项目属于OpenAI、甲骨文和软银支持的「星际之门」AI基建计划，一直面临当地反对和监管阻碍。为其供电的天然气管道尚未获新墨西哥州土地办公室批准。开发商Blue Owl和电力设备商Bloom Energy股价同步下跌。据报道，与该园区相关的约180亿美元债务报价仅为面值的89至91%。

news.titleEn: Consumers Remain Doubtful on Economy, Inflation
news.conclusionEn: The University of Michigan's final September consumer sentiment index fell to 48.1, near historic lows, while one-year inflation expectations jumped to 4.6% from 4.0%.
news.conclusionZh: 密歇根大学9月消费者信心终值降至48.1，通胀预期升至4.6%
news.whyEn: Rising inflation expectations make it harder for the Fed to stop hiking, and weak sentiment can foreshadow slower consumer spending ahead of the midterms.
news.whyZh: 通胀预期上升让美联储难以停止加息，消费疲软或拖累经济
news.detailEn: The reading was slightly better than the preliminary 47.8 and the consensus forecast, but remains about 15% below January. Five-year inflation expectations ticked up to 3.4%, well above the 2024 range. Consumers reported better buying conditions for durable goods, mainly to get ahead of expected price increases. Surging energy costs since the Iran war began are the main driver of the gloom.
news.detailZh: 该数据略好于初值47.8和市场预期，但仍比1月低约15%。5年期通胀预期升至3.4%，明显高于2024年水平。消费者认为耐用品购买条件改善，主要是想赶在涨价前出手。伊朗战争以来能源价格飙升是信心低迷的主因。

news.titleEn: Houthis Attack Saudi Arabia, Claim to Target Aramco Facilities
news.conclusionEn: Saudi Arabia said it intercepted six ballistic missiles fired by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis toward the Red Sea port of Yanbu and the city of Taif, as the group claimed to target Aramco facilities.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装向沙特延布港和塔伊夫发射导弹，称目标为阿美设施
news.whyEn: Yanbu is a key Red Sea outlet for Saudi oil; attacks there threaten one of the few export routes bypassing Hormuz.
news.whyZh: 延布是沙特绕开霍尔木兹的关键出口港，遇袭威胁原油供应
news.detailEn: The strikes extend a September escalation in which earlier Houthi attacks wounded more than 70 people and set fire to oil facilities in southern Saudi Arabia. Clashes in Yemen have shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war. The Saudi-led coalition warned any escalation must be 'dealt with firmly.' The attacks add a risk premium to oil even as US-Iran diplomacy advances.
news.detailZh: 本月早些时候胡塞袭击已造成逾70人受伤，并令沙特南部油气设施起火，此次袭击是冲突的延续。也门境内的冲突已打破持续四年的内战休战。沙特领导的联军警告将「坚决应对」任何升级。尽管美伊外交有所推进，这些袭击仍为油价增添风险溢价。

businessTips.explanationEn: Economies of scale occur when a company's average cost per unit falls as it produces more, because fixed costs like factories, software or marketing are spread over more units. Bulk purchasing and specialization add further savings. It explains why large players can undercut smaller rivals on price. But scale has limits — beyond a point, coordination costs rise (diseconomies of scale).
businessTips.explanationZh: 规模经济是指产量增加时单位平均成本下降，因为厂房、软件、营销等固定成本被更多产品分摊，批量采购和分工也能进一步降本。这解释了大企业为何能以更低价格压制小对手。但规模有上限，超过一定程度协调成本会上升，出现规模不经济。
businessTips.exampleEn: A hyperscaler spending $1.2 trillion on data centers can buy chips and power at lower unit prices than a startup. Costco's huge purchase volumes let it negotiate low prices and still profit on thin margins.
businessTips.exampleZh: 年投1.2万亿美元建数据中心的云巨头，采购芯片和电力的单价远低于初创公司。Costco凭借庞大采购量压低进价，即使毛利很薄也能盈利。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pre-selling means taking orders or deposits for a product before you fully build it. It is the strongest form of demand validation, because people paying real money is far more reliable than survey answers. It also funds early production without outside capital. The key is being transparent about delivery timelines and offering refunds if you don't ship.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预售是在产品完全做好之前就接受订单或定金。这是最有力的需求验证方式，因为真金白银比问卷回答可靠得多，还能在没有外部融资的情况下为早期生产筹资。关键是如实说明交付时间，若无法交付要承诺退款。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before recording an online course, a creator posts an outline and offers early-bird access at 40% off; if 30 people buy in a week, they build it, otherwise they refund. A handmade-goods seller can take preorders for a new design before buying materials in bulk.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位创作者在录制网课前先发布大纲，以六折早鸟价开放预购；一周内卖出30份就开录，否则全额退款。手工品卖家也可以先接新款预订，再批量采购原料。

businessTips.explanationEn: A credit spread is the extra yield a corporate or riskier bond pays over a comparable government bond of the same maturity. It compensates investors for default risk and lower liquidity. Widening spreads signal rising fear about a borrower or the economy; narrowing spreads signal confidence. Watching spreads helps investors spot stress before it shows up in stock prices.
businessTips.explanationZh: 信用利差是公司债等风险债券相对同期限国债多付的收益率，用于补偿违约风险和流动性不足。利差扩大说明市场对借款人或经济的担忧上升，收窄则代表信心增强。关注利差能帮助投资者在股价反映之前发现风险苗头。
businessTips.exampleEn: If a 10-year Treasury yields 5.16% and a tech company's 10-year bond yields 6.2%, the spread is about 1.04 percentage points. When debt tied to Oracle's troubled data center trades at 89–91 cents on the dollar, its implied yield and spread jump, reflecting worries it may be repaid late.
businessTips.exampleZh: 若10年期美债收益率5.16%，某科技公司10年期债券收益率6.2%，信用利差约1.04个百分点。当与甲骨文问题数据中心相关的债务跌至面值的89-91%时，其隐含收益率和利差大幅上升，反映市场担心还款延迟。
